name: bayesian
prohibitions: Do not interpret a credible interval as a frequentist confidence interval.
Do not report Bayes factors without specifying prior model odds and priors.
required_reporting: State priors (or prior families) for all key parameters.
Report posterior summaries and credible intervals and label them as such.
Report PSIS-LOO diagnostics (e.g., Pareto-k) when using LOO.
